evidence: A longtime MPD user recommends Lyrion after switching, finding it easier for many clients and appreciating one interface for music and local speakers.

evidence_sources.author: disposition2
evidence_sources.excerpt: I’ve used MPD for years but recently switched to lyrion and for me, it’s a lot easier and suitable when you have many clients. It’s nice to have a single (nice) UX/UI for my music and all the “speakers” on the local network.
